preconditions.description: The number of volumes n must be between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n numbers representing the disposition of volumes.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each number in the output must be a valid volume number between 1 and n.
All volume numbers in the output must be unique.
